scope: Posthoc diagnostic only; no retraining, endpoint replacement, generation feedback, or hyperparameter selection.

definitions.content: all teacher-forced target tokens preceding the final explicit EOS; includes leading separator whitespace where tokenized separately
definitions.choice_normalized_nll: -log softmax(-candidate sequence NLL)[gold], using only the declared A/B choices
definitions.full_answer: content NLL + EOS NLL; the registered endpoint remains unchanged
definitions.eos_only: diagnostic preference from end-of-sequence likelihood after each answer; not semantic answer accuracy

initial.representation_boundary: post-adapter final hidden state at last prompt token before output head
